established.filterbank: A librosa-compatible bank was reconstructed and verified elementwise against a dumped librosa.filters.mel(sr=16000,n_fft=512,n_mels=80,fmin=0,fmax=8000,norm=slaney): max abs 1.59e-9 over 20,560 weights, all 80 bands. Key correction: librosa scales weights by 2/(f[i+2]-f[i]) with the band edges in Hz, not mel units.
established.frame_count: includeCenteredTailFrame moves the family frontend from the clamped 1100 to the official 1101 centered frames.
established.window_and_padding: Verified correct: window centered at leftPad=(512-400)>>1=56, hann with winLength-1 denominator (periodic=false), 256 zero samples padded on both sides of the signal.
established.log_guard: log(mel + 2^-24) matches transformers LOG_ZERO_GUARD_VALUE; both sides share the -16.63553237915039 floor.

decisive_negative_result.finding: Supplying the verified librosa bank changed feature parity not at all: max abs stayed 7.401313781738281 and mean 1.6993922893811946 across 88,080 coordinates (all 1101 frames now compared). The filterbank was not the dominant error.

open_contradiction.what: Two official extraction paths disagree strongly, and the frontend matches neither.
open_contradiction.path_a: _torch_extract_fbank_features on the raw waveform (STFT, mel, log; no preemphasis), which is the dump used for the 7.40 measurement.
open_contradiction.path_b: ParakeetProcessor.__call__ (the documented model-card path, which applies preemphasis), against which the current frontend measures max abs 18.02 and mean 9.25.
open_contradiction.why_it_matters: Until it is settled which path the exported graph expects, the feature contract is undefined and parity cannot be claimed in either direction.
open_contradiction.next_step: Determine what __call__ does beyond preemphasis (padding, truncation, scaling) and compare it against our signal-level preemphasis, which currently keeps x[0] and applies x[i]-0.97*x[i-1].

shipped: nothing beyond two inert additive mel options (melFilterbank, includeCenteredTailFrame), both covered by tests/lasr-ctc-mel-filterbank-override.test.ts; no preset, adapter or manifest registered.
